content.text:
Yes. Firecrawl has had several short incidents recently, but none were full outages, and everything shows as operational today (Oct 17, 2026).

**Recent incidents on the official status page (all marked "degraded"):**
- Jul 20: Interact endpoint degraded, about 44 minutes.
- Aug 26: `/interact` API `prompt` field functionality degraded, about 56 minutes.
- Sep 3: API degraded, about 16 minutes.
- Sep 5: `/scrape` degraded, about 7 minutes.
- Sep 15: `/scrape` latency degraded, about 46 minutes.

The page layout made it hard to tell which duration belongs to which title, so I paired them by position. Treat the durations as approximate.

**Third-party trackers:**
- StatusGator logged 2 incidents in the last 30 days and 68 over the last 12 months. It counts some issues Firecrawl never acknowledged, such as a 16-minute login and API access problem.
- Pingoru showed 97.78% uptime over 90 days. It listed five earlier incidents from Feb 18 to May 1, 2026, and its snapshot says the last incident resolved 23 days before it was taken.

The most recent incident was on Sep 15, a month ago.

Sources:
- [Firecrawl status history](https://status.firecrawl.dev/history)
- [StatusGator: Firecrawl](https://statusgator.com/services/firecrawl)
- [Pingoru: Firecrawl outage history](https://pingoru.io/providers/firecrawl/outage-history)
- [Pingoru: Is Firecrawl down?](https://pingoru.io/providers/firecrawl)
